title: PI Lunch & Learn
summary: A focused afternoon for attorneys, case managers, paralegals, and personal injury physicians to share knowledge, strengthen relationships, and learn together.
description: The May session leaned harder into the operational side than usual, and the room responded. Case managers and paralegals made up nearly half the attendees — the people who actually move a file day to day.
The panel covered traumatic brain injury documentation in the personal injury setting, with a clinical walkthrough followed by a long, practical Q&A.

flyer.alt: MMG PI Lunch and Learn flyer, May 2026, Miami

recap.headline: Half the room was case managers. That changed the questions.
body: The TBI panel was the draw, but the Q&A is what people remembered. When case managers and paralegals make up half a room, the questions stop being theoretical and start being about Tuesday.
Thanks to CEDA Orthopedic Group, Horizon TBI & Brain Center, and TOTI Health & Wellness for backing this one.

comments.author: Sofia Marchetti
comments.body: I sent two paralegals instead of coming myself and it was the right call. They came back with a checklist we've actually adopted.

comments.author: Renee Duplessis
comments.body: More sessions aimed at the operational staff, please. They're the ones who make or break the file and they almost never get invited to anything.

comments.author: Andrew Miller
comments.body: Heard loud and clear. Building a session specifically for case managers into the fall calendar.
